test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_has_all_lc( tags Array(LowCardinality(String)), tags_plain Array(String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_has_all_lc SELECT arr, arr FROM ( SELECT arrayConcat( arrayMap(j -> concat('t', toString(cityHash64(number, j) % 5000)), range(8)), if(number % 2 = 0, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7'], [])) AS arr FROM numbers(20000000) )
test.query: SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAll(tags, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAny(tags, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAll(tags, ['t1'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAny(tags, ['absent'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAll(tags_plain, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasSubstr(tags, ['c0', 'c1'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_all_lc WHERE hasAll(tags, materialize(['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7']))
